findings.body: Raise: Functional. The new `tools` setting overrides `workers` for work, but `doctor.py:305` and `doctor.py:422` still use `workers` to decide which SDK, project trust, and UI skills to check. With `tools = "claude"` and `workers = "codex"`, doctor can report Codex problems and exit nonzero even though Codex does no work. With the settings reversed, it can miss Codex prerequisites. This breaks the promised rule that `workers` is ignored under one tool.
findings.title: Not done: doctor ignores workers under a one-tool setting
